title: Forms
intro: Questions guests answer when they join or book. Build a form once, then show it on as many queues and services as you like. Publishing a change updates all of them at once.
readOnly: Only managers, admins and owners can change forms.
limit_other: A location can have {{count}} forms. Edit one of these instead of adding another.
emptyHint: Create a form to ask guests questions before they join or book.

editor.title: Form editor
editor.name: Form name
editor.purposeHint: Guests see this above the questions.
editor.retentionHint: 1 to 365. Answers are deleted after this.

errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to change forms.
errors.invalid_input: That can't be saved. Check the form and its limits, then try again.
errors.not_found: That form or place no longer exists. Reload and try again.

waivers.title: Waiver records
waivers.intro: Export the agreements guests accepted at this location: the form version, the time, and the name they typed. Records are deleted on the retention period below, so export what you need to keep. Every export is logged.
waivers.truncated: Only the first 5,000 records are shown. Choose a shorter range to see the rest.

retention.title: How long to keep waiver records
retention.explain: Signed waiver records are kept this long, counted from the day the guest agreed, then deleted. Guest answers and contact details are deleted on your privacy retention period instead, which can be shorter. Nothing here is legal advice: ask your own counsel how long you need to keep waivers.
retention.label: Days to keep waiver records
retention.invalid: Enter a whole number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}.
retention.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change this.

purge.title_one: {{count}} waiver record will be deleted within 30 days
purge.title_other: {{count}} waiver records will be deleted within 30 days
purge.body: The oldest was agreed on {{date}}. Download them now if you need to keep them. Deletion follows the retention period below and is not delayed.

starters.title: Sample waivers
starters.intro: Start from a generic sample and edit it for your business. Nothing is saved until you save or publish.
